Data: tet_library_v1 (vertex rule: a cell is present when it holds a tet vertex) and tet_library_v2 (overlap rule: a cell is present when a tet overlaps it) at , extracted by cage-data/extract_cage_data.py. Corner weights: experiments.lido.tetmesh.embed. Cell volume fraction: tetmesh.tet_cell_overlap (exact tet–cell overlap volume, cell volume 1). Hidden-material cell: the floor cell of a tet centroid that is absent from the occupancy; the pipeline sends that centroid to the nearest present cell. Components: scipy.ndimage.label with the face (6) and ring-1 (26) structuring elements. v2 re-tetrahedralises the same surface at the same scale, so its vertex and tet counts differ a little from v1 and each cage is drawn with its own mesh. The lattice body comes from tetmesh.lattice_tets on a 6x4x3 box with an 8-cell notch.
